items.title: Charlie Love Interview, 1960-01-16
items.q: And they played mostly by note because Emmanuel was a good reader.

ctx.x: When was the first time you ever met Big Guy? Do you remember? Me? Oh, when I was nothing but a kid. He used to come up to the town where I was in Plackman, Plackman, Louisiana. Used to come up there with Manny Perez, you know. He was a very young fellow himself at that time. And when they were going to play a dance there at the Oddfellas Hall, you know, I always kept with musicians along that time. They had a little pool hall right on there.

They were on the corner by the station. And they had a rooming house there, you know. The band used to get room there. And everybody would be out walking around the town. Louie would be in the room there blowing that clarinet. And I was crazy about the clarinet, you know, but I couldn't play it. I'd listen at him like that. And when he'd come out, you know, he'd say, hello there. I'd say, hello there, fella. He'd have a little love here. He'd say, yeah, come on in. I'd go in and sit down. He'd practice there all…
You know if Louie, did he read much or did he play mostly by ear in those days?
